ops.title: Resolve drift-verdict inputs before the write, not after
ops.description:
## Problem

`printNote` / `printDoc` (`internal/cli/print.go:39-75`) run two fallible reads on the `--json` branch *after* the mutation has already committed to the ODB:

```go
staleAfter, err := c.NoteStaleAfter(ctx)   // parses CC_NOTES_NOTE_STALE_AFTER, else reads git config
if err != nil { return err }
verdict, err := c.NoteVerdict(ctx, n, staleAfter, false)  // resolves HEAD
if err != nil { return err }
```

The five callers are all mutation verbs — `add` (`internal/cli/document.go:149`), `edit` (:239), `verify` (:284), `supersede` (:324), `expire` (:359) — plus `compact.go:39-41` and `editfile.go:110,161`. The `!jsonOut` branch does neither read and always succeeds once the entity exists.

So `CC_NOTES_NOTE_STALE_AFTER=invalid cc-notes note add "t" "b" --json` writes the note, then exits non-zero with no acknowledgement on stdout. Every MCP tool forces `--json`, so an MCP caller sees a tool failure for a write that landed and may retry it. `createEntity`'s duplicate guard (`print.go:22-33`) absorbs a byte-identical `add` retry but not an `edit`.

## Not a regression

The pre-slimming code called `c.AttachmentInfos(ctx, ...)` in the identical post-write position — also git/LFS-fallible. The v0.48.0 payload-slimming change swapped which fallible call sits there; it did not create the window.

## Fix

Hoist both inputs ahead of the mutation so a bad config fails before anything is written. `NoteStaleAfter` (`notes/notes.go:125-137`) is a config read and `NoteVerdict` (`notes/document.go:724-730`) resolves HEAD; both are knowable at command start, where every verb already calls `openClient` (`internal/cli/bootstrap.go:58-64`). The cost is widening the `kind.print` seam (`internal/cli/verbs.go:64`), which the other kinds' printers do not need — so the seam, not the reads, is the design question.

Deferred out of v0.48.0 deliberately: correcting it is a restructure of the printer seam, not a correction, and the trigger is a misconfiguration.

## Found by

gpt-5.6-sol finder + refuter pass over `a9125c9..44e820c`, confirmed high-confidence by an independent refuter.

ops.text: A malformed CC_NOTES_NOTE_STALE_AFTER makes `note add --json` fail BEFORE the note is written — the ODB has no new note after the failed command
`note add`, `note edit`, `note verify`, `doc add`, `doc edit` on --json either print an acknowledgement or leave the entity unwritten; no path both commits and returns non-zero
A regression test drives the CLI with a malformed CC_NOTES_NOTE_STALE_AFTER and asserts the entity count is unchanged after the failure
